Name: Always Lucky
Author: sskerye
Description:
[size=5][b]Always Lucky (始终幸运)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

Every day is your luckiest day. This mod keeps your daily base luck at its natural maximum — the same as the best "the spirits are very happy today" days in vanilla — so you always get the best possible odds from daily luck.

Luck bonuses from the Special Charm, lucky food, and luck-boosting equipment still apply on top, exactly as in vanilla. You can still push your luck beyond the base cap the normal way.

[size=4][b]Why install it[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]No more checking the TV fortune teller before heading to the mines or the Skull Cavern.[/*]
[*]Better everyday odds for treasure chests, monster drops, ore and gem yields, fishing treasure, and every other roll influenced by daily luck.[/*]
[*]Zero configuration — install it and play.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Fair-play notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[]Only the daily base* luck roll is maxed out. Every activity keeps its vanilla probabilities, so rare rewards are never guaranteed — you simply always play with the best daily hand the game allows.
[*]Food buffs, the Special Charm, and equipment bonuses stack on top unchanged.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Daily luck is shared by the whole farm. The host's game maintains the value, and farmhands receive it automatically. All players should install the same version.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]

Safe to remove at any time. A save loaded on the same day may keep its already-stored luck value; the next normal day roll will be random again, as in vanilla.

[line]

[size=5][b]始终幸运 (Always Lucky)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]模组功能[/b][/size]

让每一天都是你的幸运日。本模组将每日基础运气保持在自然上限——等同于原版中"精灵们今天非常开心"的最佳运气日——让你每天都能获得日常运气带来的最佳概率。

特殊魅力、幸运食物和装备提供的额外运气加成照常叠加，与原版完全一致，你仍然可以通过正常方式把运气推到基础上限之上。

[size=4][b]为什么安装[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]下矿或闯骷髅洞穴前，再也不用先看电视上占卜节目的脸色。[/*]
[*]宝箱、怪物掉落、矿石与宝石产出、钓鱼宝箱等所有受每日运气影响的判定，每天都按最佳概率进行。[/*]
[*]无需任何配置——装上即玩。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]平衡性说明[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]食物增益、特殊魅力和装备加成照常叠加，不做改动。[/*]
[*]模组只锁定每日基础*运气掷骰，所有活动仍遵循原版概率，稀有奖励不会被保证——你只是每天都拿到游戏允许的最好手气。 [/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]多人游戏[/b][/size]

每日运气由全队共享。房主的游戏负责维护该数值，其他玩家会自动同步。建议所有玩家安装相同版本。

[size=4][b]前置要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]将模组文件夹解压到游戏的 Stardew Valley/Mods 目录。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]卸载说明[/b][/size]

随时可安全卸载。当天载入的存档可能保留已保存的运气值，下一次正常跨天后会恢复原版随机生成。
